description: The converter marks every member named like an access key sensitive, which catches the GCS backup bucket's `accessKeyId` on the bucket, its properties and its create/update requests. The spec describes it as 'Access Key ID (HMAC key)': the public half of the key pair, an identifier like a key ID, while its secret (`secretAccessKey`, 'Secret Access Key (HMAC secret key)') stays sensitive. IDs stay plain strings (distilled-sdk skill, Credentials). Source: the OpenAPI document served at https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1 (2026-11-11).
